result.brief: GameWAM 提出面向视频游戏的 World-Action Model，联合生成未来视觉观测与可执行键鼠动作轨迹，采用并行视觉-动作生成、块因果条件与流匹配，并揭示动作源低频成分影响生成相机运动的失效模式。
result.reason: Unifies world dynamics prediction and action generation in a World-Action Model for games, with joint visual-action generative processes and flow matching—directly a video/multimodal world model contribution.
